fee_notes: $2,500 for Self-Acquired Accounts only (no Initial Plan). Initial Plan tiers: Tier 1 ($8,000/yr billings) = $6,510; Tier 2 ($50,000/yr) = $18,795; Tier 3 ($85,000/yr) = $29,385. Fee partially refundable if franchisor fails to deliver promised Account Gross Billings within agreed timeframe.
raw_excerpt: This fee is $2500 if you elect not to purchase an Initial Plan from us. If you elect to purchase an Initial Plan from us, the Initial Franchise Fee ranges from $6510 to $29,385.
